database-migrations.evidence: Supabase project ujotgzjpkocuhtfrvbzu (Aura organization, ap-south-1 Mumbai; production since 2026-11-05) checked 2026-11-05: remote migration history matches the repository through 20261105130000 (all 15 migrations at the move); 20261105140000 (start_board_session, service_role only) was applied and checked on 2026-11-05, so all 16 are applied; the schema matches a local build (35 tables, all with row-level security, 29 policies, 9 functions, the auth.users trigger and the board-assets bucket); data copied from the previous Seoul project ljqxegqdfhqcmkbivldr with matching row counts in all 38 tables and matching content fingerprints. Earlier check on ljqxegqdfhqcmkbivldr, 2026-08-04: remote migration history matches the repository through 20260804100000; public-schema lint reports no errors; rotate_chrome_installation_credential, commit_chrome_installation_consent, and complete_chrome_installation_preflight are SECURITY DEFINER functions executable by postgres and service_role only, with anon and authenticated explicitly denied.

automated-regression.description: Type checks, unit tests, builds, voice evaluations and browser journeys pass on the release commit.
automated-regression.evidence: Release candidate 14151b6 verified 2026-08-04: frozen pnpm install; 513/513 workspace tests; all 8 workspace typechecks and builds; docs check; PR evaluation suite including Meet bridge replay; Playwright 45 passed and 2 intentionally skipped; draft extension 0.8.0 package SHA-256 9347a8a433c502d321047592e72f2b78c3deb811d70c1a62dc80bfe1fc612a80.
automated-regression.notes: The Chrome deployment compatibility check, Store release packaging, real two-client Meet acceptance, and rollback exercise remain separate pending gates and are not implied by this source-level verification.

commercial-smoke.description: The commercial customer journey passes against the release database.
commercial-smoke.notes: Required from standalone GA (moved out of the controlled pilot on 2026-11-05). Run pnpm smoke:commercial against a disposable release organization.

deployment-smoke.description: Production web, API, authentication, readiness, board save/export/delete and rollback smoke checks pass.
deployment-smoke.evidence: Docs/Release Readiness Backlog.md — 2026-11-04 signed-in production smoke and 2026-11-05 rollback drill (web launch-a0d7ed4 → launch-a226e33 → launch-a0d7ed4).
deployment-smoke.notes: 2026-11-04 signed-in production pass in the browser (sign-in, board open, typed command, save, reload persistence, undo, two-tab conflict, Export PNG, Trash/restore, trial-ended state). 2026-11-05 rollback drill: web traffic moved to the previous revision launch-a226e33 in 5s (verified by its copy), pages served 200, then rolled forward to launch-a0d7ed4 in 4s; 16s on the previous revision in total. Every deploy since is staged at 0% on a tag, smoked, then promoted.

lifecycle-schedule.description: The authenticated lifecycle endpoint runs on a schedule and its failed runs are recorded in the logs.
lifecycle-schedule.evidence: Docs/Release Readiness Backlog.md — 2026-11-05 lifecycle schedule: hourly Cloud Scheduler job airboard-lifecycle-hourly; a failed step returns 500 LIFECYCLE_STEP_FAILED, which Cloud Scheduler logs at ERROR and the log-based metric airboard_lifecycle_failed_runs counts. Checked 2026-11-05: the job is enabled and the 16:00, 17:00 and 18:00 UTC runs returned 200.
lifecycle-schedule.notes: 2026-11-05: Cloud Scheduler job airboard-lifecycle-hourly (asia-south1, 0 * * * * UTC) POSTs /internal/lifecycle/run with the airboard-cron-secret bearer; manual and scheduler runs return 200. Since API launch-e0545e8, any failed lifecycle step returns 500 LIFECYCLE_STEP_FAILED. Alerting: log-based metric airboard_lifecycle_failed_runs counts scheduler attempts that finish at ERROR; the metric alert 'Airboard lifecycle run failed' (count > 0 per 60s) notifies hellosigmascience@gmail.com. The first alert, a log-match policy, never fired and was replaced (the Monitoring notification service agent also had to be created). Proof: a temporary wrong-bearer job failed at 19:38:26Z, the metric counted it, and the policy opened an incident at 19:42:17Z, seen on a temporary Pub/Sub channel then removed with the test job. The user confirmed the 19:42 UTC alert email arrived at hellosigmascience@gmail.com. 2026-11-06 (founder's decision): no alerts go to the support inbox, which carries customer mail only, so the 'Airboard lifecycle run failed' policy was deleted. Alerting on failed runs is part of the standalone-GA monitoring-alerts gate.

legal-approval.description: Counsel approves the legal entity details, privacy notice, terms, DPA and deletion obligations.
legal-approval.notes: Do not relabel draft pages until signed approval exists.

subprocessor-review.description: Contractual provider entities, locations, transfer terms and notification process are approved.
subprocessor-review.notes: Confirm Supabase, Google Cloud, Deepgram, OpenAI, Stripe and Resend details.

threat-model.description: A reviewed data-flow and abuse-case threat model covers all production channels and providers.
threat-model.notes: Complete review with owners and remediation dates.

independent-security-test.description: Independent testing has no unresolved critical or high finding.
independent-security-test.notes: Commission testing after the release candidate is stable.

backup-restore.description: A production-like backup restore proves the stated recovery point and recovery time.
backup-restore.notes: Run and time a restore; record data validation.

incident-exercise.description: The team completes an incident and breach-notification tabletop exercise.
incident-exercise.notes: Record roles, contacts, decisions and improvements.

browser-matrix.description: The promised standalone desktop browser and OS matrix passes with documented exclusions.
browser-matrix.notes: Test Chrome, Edge and Safari only where explicitly promised.

accessibility-audit.description: Core non-media workflows pass an accessibility audit and published limitations are accurate.
accessibility-audit.notes: Audit keyboard, focus, reduced motion, contrast and screen-reader paths.

monitoring-alerts.description: Web, API, database, provider, error-rate, latency and lifecycle alerts route to an accountable responder.

public-status-process.description: A real public incident page and update process replace the current placeholder.
public-status-process.notes: Connect a status provider before making uptime claims.

support-sla.description: Published support hours and response targets match actual staffing.
support-sla.notes: Set a target only after coverage is staffed.

email-domain.description: The production sending domain, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and lifecycle templates are verified.
email-domain.notes: Attach Resend domain and delivery-test evidence.

auth-production.description: Magic-link and every advertised OAuth provider pass production redirect, logout, expiry and recovery tests.
auth-production.notes: Advertise only the providers returned by /auth/config.

paid-offer-approval.description: Packaging, currency, geography, contract, trial, renewal and cancellation language are approved.
paid-offer-approval.notes: Replace proposed pricing copy only after approval.

tax-refund-policy.description: Tax collection, invoices, refunds and chargeback ownership are operational.
tax-refund-policy.notes: Confirm supported countries before accepting payment.

stripe-live-journey.description: Live-mode checkout, webhook, entitlement, invoice, portal, failure and cancellation paths pass.
stripe-live-journey.notes: Use a controlled live transaction and reconcile every resulting record.

billing-reconciliation.description: Daily Stripe-to-Airboard reconciliation and failed-webhook alerting are owned.

chrome-deployment-compatibility.description: The deployed web renderer and API report the same bridge protocol and extension version, and both restrict trust/credentials to the packaged release's exact Web Store ID.
chrome-deployment-compatibility.notes: Deploy the release web/API first, then retain the successful pnpm verify:extension-deployment output.

chrome-store-approval.description: The production Chrome extension is approved and publicly installable.
chrome-store-approval.notes: Record the reviewed store URL and version.

meet-receiver-matrix.description: Two-account receiver-side Meet tests pass across the promised role and device matrix.
meet-receiver-matrix.notes: Verify the audience result, reconnect and fail-safe behavior.

chrome-permission-review.description: Chrome permissions and privacy disclosures exactly match runtime behavior.
chrome-permission-review.notes: Review the packaged artifact, not only source.

chrome-rollback.description: Extension kill switch, version rollback and user communication are proven.
chrome-rollback.notes: Exercise a disabled or withdrawn release.

desktop-signing.description: Production desktop artifacts are signed with controlled keys.
desktop-signing.notes: Record key custody and signature verification.

desktop-notarization.description: macOS notarization and Windows reputation/install checks pass.

desktop-updater.description: Signed automatic updates, staged rollout and downgrade behavior pass.
desktop-updater.notes: Do not distribute generally without an update path.

desktop-os-matrix.description: The promised desktop OS, display, permission and presentation matrix passes.
desktop-os-matrix.notes: Document excluded operating systems and display configurations.

desktop-rollback.description: Desktop release rollback and revoked-build communication are proven.
